calibration_unit: original WSI; deduplicated pooled internal WSI; individual TMA core
eligibility: original instance with at least 5 finite valid pixels, independent of labels and geometry QC
outer_weighting: one equal-weight statistic per eligible original instance; not pixel weighted
lower_bound: P1 of eligible instance P10 values
upper_bound: P99 of eligible instance P90 values
empty_or_invalid: retain all original keys; calibration_invalid and NaN derived inputs
clipping_population_for_audit: finite pixels in eligible original instances; each unique global pixel counted once
whole_image_context: same mapping for target, neighboring and reference pixels; no per-tile refit
provenance_note: Literature-guided combination; the cited papers do not establish this exact nested formula as optimal for CD8.
